sections.title: Pittsburgh's Defining AI Markets
sections.description: ClickMasters builds AI specifically for Pittsburgh's world-class robotics, healthcare, manufacturing, and financial services sectors.

items.title: Autonomous Vehicles and Robotics (Pittsburgh's Defining AI Market)
items.description: Pittsburgh's role as a US autonomous vehicle development center — Waymo's Pittsburgh operations, Aurora Innovation (founded by former Google, Tesla, and Uber AV leaders), Argo AI alumni dispersed through Pittsburgh's AV ecosystem, and Carnegie Robotics (CMU spinoff) — creates AI requirements that few other US markets can match: autonomous vehicle perception (lidar point cloud processing — PointPillars, VoxelNet, CenterPoint — camera-based 3D detection, radar processing, multi-modal sensor fusion), robotic manipulation and inspection (industrial robot programming for complex manipulation tasks, visual servoing for robot guidance, autonomous inspection), and drone and aerial systems AI (autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, inspection AI for infrastructure, energy, and agriculture).
items.label: Pittsburgh specialty

items.title: Healthcare and Medical Research
items.description: UPMC (Pittsburgh HQ, 40+ hospitals, health insurance arm) and Allegheny Health Network. UPMC's partnership with CMU makes Pittsburgh's clinical AI ecosystem one of the most technically sophisticated in the US: patient risk stratification with Epic FHIR integration, medical imaging AI for UPMC's radiology and pathology programs, and clinical trial analytics for UPMC and University of Pittsburgh's research programs.
items.label: Healthcare

items.title: Advanced Manufacturing and Materials
items.description: Pittsburgh's post-steel manufacturing — MSA Safety (Pittsburgh HQ, mining and industrial safety equipment), Kennametal (tooling and advanced materials), and the advanced manufacturing companies that have replaced traditional steel production. Predictive maintenance, materials characterization AI, and manufacturing quality inspection.
items.label: Manufacturing

items.title: PNC Financial Services
items.description: PNC Financial Services (Pittsburgh HQ, top-10 US bank). Credit risk, fraud detection, customer analytics, and financial document processing AI for Pittsburgh's leading financial institution.
